name: Inspector
author: Umbrella Chronicles PC port
description: Shows live what the mod API sees: both players, the mission, the camera, the pad, the nearest enemies, a log of game events and any memory address you type. Read only; the gear button opens its window.

tooltip.en: The nearest ones to the camera.

label.en: Snapshot to the log every (game seconds, 0 = never)
label.ru: Снимок в журнал каждые (игровых секунд, 0 = никогда)

tooltip.en: Writes one line of JSON to debug\mods.log. The game keeps the first 2000 log lines of a mod per session.
tooltip.ru: Пишет одну строку JSON в debug\mods.log. Игра хранит только первые 2000 строк журнала мода за сеанс.
